    el.elo.setAttribute('opacity', f(oo));
    el.ero.setAttribute('opacity', f(oo));
    el.elc.setAttribute('opacity', f(co));
    el.erc.setAttribute('opacity', f(co));
    for (var q = 0; q < lids.length; q++) lids[q].setAttribute('stroke-width', f(lt));

    // mouth
    el.mouth.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + f(mcx) + ' ' + f(mcy) + ') rotate(' + f(mrot) + ')');
    var cw = 0.85 * w, cd = 1.33 * d;
    var upper = 'M ' + f(-w) + ' 0 Q 0 ' + f(2 * ub) + ' ' + f(w) + ' 0';
    var inside = upper + ' C ' + f(cw) + ' ' + f(cd) + ', ' + f(-cw) + ' ' + f(cd) + ', ' + f(-w) + ' 0 Z';
    el.mclip.setAttribute('d', inside);
    el.minside.setAttribute('d', inside);
    el.ulip.setAttribute('d', upper);
    el.ulips.setAttribute('d', 'M ' + f(-w) + ' 0.9 Q 0 ' + f(2 * ub + 0.9) + ' ' + f(w) + ' 0.9');
    el.teeth.setAttribute('d', upper + ' L ' + f(w) + ' ' + f(th) + ' Q 0 ' + f(2 * ub + th) + ' ' + f(-w) + ' ' + f(th) + ' Z');
    el.tongue.setAttribute('cy', f(d));
    el.tongue.setAttribute('rx', f(0.72 * w));
    el.tongue.setAttribute('ry', f(0.5 * d));
    el.llip.setAttribute('d', 'M ' + f(-w - 1) + ' 3 C ' + f(-cw) + ' ' + f(cd + 4) + ', ' + f(cw) + ' ' + f(cd + 4) + ', ' + f(w + 1) + ' 3');
    el.corners.setAttribute('d',
      'M ' + f(-w - 2) + ' -4 Q ' + f(-w - 5) + ' 0 ' + f(-w - 1) + ' 5 M ' + f(w + 2) + ' -4 Q ' + f(w + 5) + ' 0 ' + f(w + 1) + ' 5');

    // torso (body + arms) leans / grows a little
    el.torso.setAttribute('transform',
      'translate(' + f(bx) + ' 0) translate(126 240) scale(' + f(bs) + ') translate(-126 -240)');

    // neck anchors: two points inside the head, mapped into torso space, so the body always tucks under the head
    var rad = hr * Math.PI / 180, cs = Math.cos(rad), sn = Math.sin(rad);
    function anchor(x, y) {
      var rx = (x - 138) * hs, ry = (y - 118) * hs;
      var X = 138 + rx * cs - ry * sn + hx, Y = 118 + rx * sn + ry * cs + hy;
      return [(X - bx - 126) / bs + 126, (Y - 240) / bs + 240];
    }
    var L = anchor(86, 117), R = anchor(188, 117);
    var bd = 'M 14 240 C 15 205, 22 172, 36 150 C 48 132, ' + f(L[0] - 17) + ' ' + f(L[1] + 7) + ', ' +
      f(L[0]) + ' ' + f(L[1]) + ' L ' + f(R[0]) + ' ' + f(R[1]) + ' C ' + f(R[0] + 14) + ' ' + f(R[1] + 7) +
      ', 212 132, 220 146 C 230 164, 236 200, 238 240 Z';
    el.body.setAttribute('d', bd);
    el.bclip.setAttribute('d', bd);
    el.nshadow.setAttribute('cx', f((138 + hx - bx - 126) / bs + 126));

    // arms and hands
    el.armL.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + f(hlx * 0.3) + ' ' + f(hly * 0.3) + ')');
    el.handL.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + f(hlx * 0.7) + ' ' + f(hly * 0.7) + ')');
    el.armR.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + f(hrx * 0.3) + ' ' + f(hry * 0.3) + ')');
    el.handR.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + f(hrx * 0.7) + ' ' + f(hry * 0.7) + ')');
  }

  window.nwb = { render: render };
  render(0);
})();
</script>
